PSA: the birthday girl is DJing her OWN coronation and it's about to get loud 🎂💖

This Sunday, Azúcar's Main Floor turns into an all-pink drag house party thrown by Revolutionary Riot Productions — and it's Sir Knight Haven Rexia's 21st. She's out from behind the decks to host alongside Liquor while DJ Phish Tahko spins every 2000s/2010s banger you used to scream into a hairbrush.

Rohla Blunt, Slayonce, Cherry Pop, Ember Rexia, Fae Tality, Victoria Demizer Night, and Aurora Haven are turning your favorite guilty pleasures into full drag spectacle. Confetti's flying, heels are clicking, and the whole room is losing it for the birthday girl.

This lineup doesn't repeat and doors open early — get in before it's standing room only.

📅 Sunday, July 19 — Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$25
🔞 21+

Come as you are, leave screaming every lyric with people who just became your favorite people 💕

The White Gurls Bangers Drag Show is a Latinx-run house party dressed up in drag — no attitude, no judgment, just glitter, confetti, and a floor full of folks losing it together. Rohla Blunt, Slayonce, Cherry Pop, Ember Rexia, Fae Tality, Victoria Demizer Night, and Aurora Haven bringing the performances, DJ Phish Tahko bringing the soundtrack, Sir Knight Haven Rexia and Liquor hosting the room.

This one's extra special — it's Haven's 21st birthday, so grab your people, wear the outfit you've been saving, and come hype her into her new era. Everyone's welcome, everyone's family for the night.

Guilty pleasures only. Bring your loudest voice.
